title: Async Resource / DB Pool Context Manager Leak Prevention
description: Fix an async connection pool so acquired connections are released even when exceptions occur, exhausted pools raise PoolExhaustedError instead of deadlocking, and the checked-out gauge is decremented on release.

files.pool.py:
import asyncio
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager


class PoolExhaustedError(Exception):
    """Raised when no connection becomes available before timeout."""
    pass


class ConnectionPool:
    def __init__(self, factory, max_size=2, acquire_timeout=0.1):
        self.factory = factory
        self.max_size = max_size
        self.acquire_timeout = acquire_timeout
        self._available = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=max_size)
        self._size = 0
        self._checked_out = 0
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    @property
    def checked_out(self):
        return self._checked_out

    @asynccontextmanager
    async def acquire(self, timeout=None):
        conn = await self._acquire(timeout)
        self._checked_out += 1
        yield conn
        await self._release(conn)

    async def _acquire(self, timeout):
        async with self._lock:
            if self._size < self.max_size:
                conn = await self.factory()
                self._size += 1
                return conn

        if timeout is None:
            timeout = self.acquire_timeout

        # BUG: timeout is accepted but never applied, so an exhausted pool waits forever.
        return await self._available.get()

    async def _release(self, conn):
        await self._available.put(conn)
        # BUG: the checked-out gauge is never decremented.

import asyncio
import unittest

from pool import ConnectionPool, PoolExhaustedError


async def make_connection():
    return object()


class TestConnectionPool(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_release_on_exception(self):
        pool = ConnectionPool(make_connection, max_size=1)

        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            async with pool.acquire():
                raise ValueError("boom")

        self.assertEqual(pool.checked_out, 0)

        async with pool.acquire() as conn:
            self.assertIsNotNone(conn)

    async def test_timeout_when_exhausted(self):
        pool = ConnectionPool(make_connection, max_size=1)

        async def attempt():
            async with pool.acquire(timeout=0.05):
                pass

        async with pool.acquire():
            with self.assertRaises(PoolExhaustedError):
                await asyncio.wait_for(attempt(), timeout=0.2)

    async def test_checked_out_gauge_decremented(self):
        pool = ConnectionPool(make_connection, max_size=2)

        async with pool.acquire():
            self.assertEqual(pool.checked_out, 1)

        self.assertEqual(pool.checked_out, 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
